title: Best of Sri Lanka | Honeymoon Special
highlights: Share breathtaking sunset views from scenic hilltops, where the sky’s vibrant colors blend with lush landscapes, creating memories together.
Wander through Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where colonial charm seamlessly blends with stunning coastal views and historical architecture.
Discover the sacred Buddhist relic at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, nestled in a historic royal setting rich with spiritual significance.
Marvel at the stunning Ramboda Falls, where the cascading waters plunge through lush, verdant landscapes, creating a breathtaking landscape.
Cruise along the tranquil Madu Ganga river, exploring serene mangroves and observing the rich biodiversity of this unique ecosystem.
overview:
Sri Lanka is one of the most ancient and beautiful countries in the world. The island nation offers serene and secluded spaces to people looking to spend quality time with their loved ones and offers an assortment of places to see from rolling green mountains, lakes, natural forest sanctuaries, ancient heritage temples, waterfalls, lush tea plantations, and opulent & modern buildings.
The travelers love the weather in Sri Lanka. Couples love to stroll amidst the gentle sea breeze, warm sunshine, and the occasional downpours. The native Sri Lankans are warm, friendly, and inviting that making the travelers feel welcomed and relaxed.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | En Route Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Half Day Tour to Kandy
days.desc: Welcome to Colombo! Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to Kandy. En route, make a stop at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to feed and observe elephants. Then, continue to Kandy. Check in at your hotel and relax for a while. Then, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a revered Buddhist site housing a sacred relic of Buddha. Visit the Bahirawakanda Vihara Buddha Statue, Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens, and other attractions. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Nuwara Eliya | Day Tour to Nuwara Eliya
days.desc: After checking out, you'll be transferred to Nuwara Eliya. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Then, embark on a sightseeing tour of Nuwara Eliya. Start with a visit to the serene Hakgala Botanical Gardens, known for its vibrant flora. Explore Gregory Lake, where you can enjoy scenic views and water activities. Explore Ramboda Falls, Seetha Amman Kovil, Hanuman Temple, and other attractions for a scenic view and spiritual touch. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Bentota | Visit Madu Ganga Boat Safari and Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: After checking out, you'll be transferred to Bentota. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax for a while. Start your day with a scenic boat ride on the Madu River, a serene waterway rich in biodiversity, including 64 islands and lush mangrove forests. Next, visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery to learn about conservation efforts for Hawksbill and Leatherback turtles. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Tour to Bentota Beach and Galle Fort
days.desc: In the morning, you'll embark on a sightseeing tour to Bentota Beach and Galle. Start with a visit to Bentota Beach, where you can soak up stunning Indian Ocean views and indulge in various water sports like jet skiing, banana boat rides, and parasailing. Then, you'll head to the historic Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, to explore landmarks like the Galle Lighthouse, the serene Meera Mosque, and more. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out, you'll be transferred to Colombo. Upon arrival, you'll be driven to your hotel. Check in and relax for a while. Start your city tour with a visit to the iconic Lotus Tower, where you can take in breathtaking views of Colombo's skyline. Next, visit the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, renowned for its stunning architecture. Continue to the Pettah Floating Market, Colombo Fort, the Suspension Bridge, and other notable attractions. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
